title: Jamaican Yam Flatbread
description: A delicious flatbread topped with a flavorful yam mixture, inspired by Jamaican cuisine. This dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Cut the flatbread into desired shapes.
In a pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the diced yam and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the Jamaican seasoning, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
Brush the flatbread with a little coconut oil and top with the yam mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
